title: An etale algebra over a normal ring is a normal ring
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. If $A$ is a normal ring [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], then $B$ is a normal ring.
